_comment: The cmux NEXT PR fast tier (scripts/cmux-next/fast-tier.py, hq#1915, cx-29ch2). Every feat-cmux-next PR runs every entry on an owned Mac without the gui token. An entry is deterministic (fixed seeds, virtual clock, no sleeps), needs no window server or daemon process, runs within 60 s after the build, and names a stable ID in each failure line. It gates only after `fast-tier.py --only NAME --repeat 20` passes on one head.
